title: Size of the binarized circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, and suppose each gate has pairwise distinct arguments and every negation gate has exactly one argument. The size of its binarization is at most $n+|G|(|C|+2)$, where $G$ is the list of gates of $C$ and $|C|=n+|G|$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit on n inputs
Each gate has pairwise distinct arguments
Each negation gate has exactly one argument
